newsitem.title: FINLAND: Kemira sees better full-year 1996 profit.
newsitem.headline: Kemira sees better full-year 1996 profit.

text.p: Finnish chemicals group Kemira Oy said in a statement on Thursday it expects its full-year 1996 pre-tax profit to mprove on the 721 million markka profit booked in 1995.
"The group's management expects that the full-year 1996 profit before tax is better than in 1995," Kemira said.

The slow-down in Kemira's pigments division will not have any major impact on the group's full-year operating profit as it will be offset by improving profitability in three other core businesses, Kemira said.
In August, Kemira said it expects its consolidated full-year operating profit to be roughly on par with last year's despite a weak performance for its pigments unit.
Kemira said earlier its January-August profit before extraordinary items, taxes rose to 612 million markka from 524 million in the first eight months in 1995.
